Anticipates Abraham Abulafia's prophetic-Kabbalah by centuries (Scholem 1965). The breathing-meditation register is the *pĕrûš bi-lšôn ṭohŏrâ* 'interpretation in the tongue of purity' convention.

paragraphs.he: שִׁעוּר קוֹמָה. פ ג
paragraphs.translit: Šiʿūr Qōmâ. P[ereq] G[immel]

i18n.en: Shi'ur Qomah. Chapter 3.

paragraphs.commentary: Structural heading: *Perek Gimmel* 'Chapter 3', the alphabetic-acrostic hymn appended to the body-measurement core. Functions as the liturgical-closing companion piece.

paragraphs.he: אֵל בְּמַאֲמָרְךָ אֲדוֹנֵינוּ צֶדֶק צְבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל מְיַחֲלֵי צִדְקֶךָ. בְּךָ יַצְדִּיקוּ סֶלָה. צִדְקוֹתֶיךָ יְרוֹמְמוּ לְרוֹמֵם לְךָ יַחַד יִפְצְחוּ פֶּה יַעֲנוּ וְיֹאמְרוּ: «יְהוָה אֲדוֹנֵינוּ מָה אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ».
paragraphs.translit: ʾēl bĕ-maʾămārĕḵā ʾăḏōnēnū Ṣedeq ṣĕḇāʾ Yiśrāʾēl mĕyaḥălē ṣiḏqeḵā. Bĕ-ḵā yaṣdīqū selâ. Ṣiḏqōteḵā yĕrōmĕmū lĕ-rōmēm lĕ-ḵā yaḥaḏ yip̄ṣĕḥū peh yaʿănū wĕ-yōʾmĕrū: 'YHWH ʾăḏōnēnū mâ ʾaddīr šimḵā.'

i18n.en: God, by your word, our Lord — Righteousness, host of Israel, those who hope for your righteousness; in you they are justified, Selah. Your righteousnesses they shall exalt, to exalt you together they shall open the mouth, answer, and say: 'YHWH our Lord, how majestic is your name' [Ps 8:2].

paragraphs.commentary: Opening of the alphabetic-acrostic hymn. Scriptural anchor Ps 8:2 ('YHWH our Lord, how majestic is your Name'). The Hebrew אֲדוֹנֵינוּ is rendered 'our Lord' per standard Anglophone Jewish-studies convention.

paragraphs.he: אַתָּה אַדִּיר וְשִׁמְךָ אַדִּיר. אַתָּה אַמִּיץ וְשִׁמְךָ אַמִּיץ. אַתָּה אַבִּיר וְשִׁמְךָ אַבִּיר. אַתָּה בָּרוּךְ וְשִׁמְךָ בָּרוּךְ. אַתָּה בָּרוּר וְשִׁמְךָ בָּרוּר. אַתָּה גָּדוֹל וְשִׁמְךָ גָּדוֹל. אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר וְשִׁמְךָ גִּבּוֹר. אַתָּה גֵּאֶה וְשִׁמְךָ גֵּאֶה ‹...›.
paragraphs.translit: ʾattâ ʾaddīr wĕ-šimḵā ʾaddīr. ʾattâ ʾammīṣ wĕ-šimḵā ʾammīṣ. ʾattâ ʾabbīr wĕ-šimḵā ʾabbīr. ʾattâ bārūḵ wĕ-šimḵā bārūḵ. ʾattâ bārūr wĕ-šimḵā bārūr. ʾattâ gāḏōl wĕ-šimḵā gāḏōl. ʾattâ gibbōr wĕ-šimḵā gibbōr. ʾattâ gēʾeh wĕ-šimḵā gēʾeh ‹...›.

i18n.en: You are mighty and your Name is mighty. You are strong and your Name is strong. You are valiant and your Name is valiant. You are blessed and your Name is blessed. You are pure and your Name is pure. You are great and your Name is great. You are powerful and your Name is powerful. You are exalted and your Name is exalted ⟨…⟩.

paragraphs.commentary: **Acrostic hymn** — 'You are X and your Name is X.' The triple-name liturgical pattern is late-antique piyyut form. Each epithet is paired with itself as divine-Name: divine-attribute = divine-Name (the *šēm wĕ-ṣiwwâh* identity formula). Many epithets have multiple valid English equivalents; the translation uses standard scholarly conventions while preserving the structural triplet.

paragraphs.he: אַתָּה דָּגוּל וְשִׁמְךָ דָּגוּל. אַתָּה דַּיָּן וְשִׁמְךָ דַּיָּן. אַתָּה הוֹד וְשִׁמְךָ הוֹד וְהָדָר. אַתָּה הָדוּר וְשִׁמְךָ הָדוּר. אַתָּה וָתִיק וְשִׁמְךָ וָתִיק. אַתָּה וָעֵד וְשִׁמְךָ וָעֵד. אַתָּה זַךְ וְשִׁמְךָ זַךְ. אַתָּה חָסִין וְשִׁמְךָ חָסִין. אַתָּה חַנּוּן וְשִׁמְךָ חַנּוּן. אַתָּה ח‹...›. אַתָּה טָהוֹר וְשִׁמְךָ טָהוֹר. אַתָּה יָחִיד וְשִׁמְךָ יָחִיד.
paragraphs.translit: ʾattâ dāḡūl wĕ-šimḵā dāḡūl. ʾattâ dayyān wĕ-šimḵā dayyān. ʾattâ hōḏ wĕ-šimḵā hōḏ wĕ-hāḏār. ʾattâ hāḏūr wĕ-šimḵā hāḏūr. ʾattâ wātīq wĕ-šimḵā wātīq. ʾattâ wāʿēḏ wĕ-šimḵā wāʿēḏ. ʾattâ zaḵ wĕ-šimḵā zaḵ. ʾattâ ḥāsīn wĕ-šimḵā ḥāsīn. ʾattâ ḥannūn wĕ-šimḵā ḥannūn. ʾattâ ḥ‹...›. ʾattâ ṭāhōr wĕ-šimḵā ṭāhōr. ʾattâ yāḥīḏ wĕ-šimḵā yāḥīḏ.

i18n.en: You are distinguished and your Name is distinguished. You are judge and your Name is judge. You are majesty and your Name is majesty and splendor. You are splendid and your Name is splendid. You are enduring and your Name is enduring. You are appointed and your Name is appointed. You are pure and your Name is pure. You are mighty and your Name is mighty. You are gracious and your Name is gracious. You are Ḥ⟨…⟩. You are clean and your Name is clean. You are unique and your Name is unique.

paragraphs.commentary: Acrostic continuation through letters dalet-yod. *yāḥîd* ('unique/only') at letter yod is theologically loaded (cf. Shemaʿ's *YHWH ʾeḥād* 'YHWH is one'). The English collisions (zaḵ='pure' / ṭāhôr='pure'-or-'clean') are unavoidable in the acrostic-typology constraints.

paragraphs.he: אַתָּה כַּבִּיר וְשִׁמְךָ כַּבִּיר. אַתָּה לוֹהֵט וְשִׁמְךָ לוֹהֵט. אַתָּה ‹...›. אַתָּה נוֹרָא וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא. אַתָּה נֶעֱרָץ וְשִׁמְךָ נֶעֱרָץ. אַתָּה סוֹבֵל וְשִׁמְךָ סוֹבֵל. אַתָּה עִזּוּז וְשִׁמְךָ עִזּוּז. אַתָּה פּוֹדֶה וְשִׁמְךָ פּוֹדֶה. אַתָּה צַדִּיק וְשִׁמְךָ צַדִּיק. אַתָּה צַח וְשִׁמְךָ צַח. אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ. אַתָּה רַחוּם וְשִׁמְךָ רַחוּם. אַתָּה שַׁדַּי וְשִׁמְךָ שַׁדַּי. אַתָּה תָּמִים וְשִׁמְךָ תָּמִים. ‹...› בָּרוּךְ ‹...›.
paragraphs.translit: ʾattâ kabbīr wĕ-šimḵā kabbīr. ʾattâ lōhēṭ wĕ-šimḵā lōhēṭ. ʾattâ ‹...›. ʾattâ nōrāʾ wĕ-šimḵā nōrāʾ. ʾattâ neʿĕrāṣ wĕ-šimḵā neʿĕrāṣ. ʾattâ sōḇēl wĕ-šimḵā sōḇēl. ʾattâ ʿizzūz wĕ-šimḵā ʿizzūz. ʾattâ pōḏeh wĕ-šimḵā pōḏeh. ʾattâ ṣaddīq wĕ-šimḵā ṣaddīq. ʾattâ ṣaḥ wĕ-šimḵā ṣaḥ. ʾattâ qādōš wĕ-šimḵā qādōš. ʾattâ raḥūm wĕ-šimḵā raḥūm. ʾattâ Šadday wĕ-šimḵā Šadday. ʾattâ tāmīm wĕ-šimḵā tāmīm. ‹...› bārūḵ ‹...›.

i18n.en: You are mighty and your Name is mighty. You are ablaze and your Name is ablaze. You are ⟨…⟩. You are awesome and your Name is awesome. You are feared and your Name is feared. You are long-suffering and your Name is long-suffering. You are strong and your Name is strong. You are redeemer and your Name is redeemer. You are righteous and your Name is righteous. You are pure and your Name is pure. You are holy and your Name is holy. You are merciful and your Name is merciful. You are Shadday and your Name is Shadday. You are perfect and your Name is perfect. ⟨…⟩ blessed ⟨…⟩.

paragraphs.commentary: Acrostic completion through letter taw. *Šadday* preserved untranslated per Hebrew-Bible-glossary convention (the canonical divine name). The closing *bārûḵ* doxology anchors the entire chapter back into the standard berakhah-formula.
